integrity: A complete original proof, six exact independent finite-volume checks and standalone verifier are provided; no external independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge wheels only; polar volume is in the hub-anchored dual coordinates. The explicit primal volume is previously published. An equivalent unindexed transfer-operator evaluation remains a bibliographic possibility. The analytic argument proves the all-dimensional statement; finite exact checks are supporting evidence.
title: A spectral volume law and exponential Mahler growth for wheel Lipschitz-free spaces
